hooks.desc: A monster's spell fizzles: the air crackles around it
An alarm sounds: robbing a shop (the Keystone Kops come) or entering a vault's security area
A beehive on the level: an angry drone (also a bee buzzing angrily)
Iron bars dissolved by acid hiss like angry snakes
A shopkeeper shouts at you for damaging the shop ("Out of my way, scum!")
Killing a peaceful while hallucinating: the studio audience applauds
A pet bird (parrot, raven...) screaks when you hurt or abuse it
Digging with a blade that isn't for digging: "Bang! You hit with the broad side"
Gold, silver or coins hit iron bars: "Clink"
A weapon or other object hits iron bars: "Clonk"
Something flimsy (a scroll, cloth...) hits iron bars: "Flapp"
A boulder or heavy iron ball hits iron bars: "Whang"
A harmless missile (a cream pie, an egg...) hits iron bars: "Whap"
A beehive on the level (hallucinating): bees in your bonnet
An explosion out of sight: "You hear a blast"
A monster steps on a squeaky board (seen, or heard near or far); its note plays too
You step on a squeaky board; its note plays too
A monster's wand of striking hits you but your magic resistance stops it: "Boing!"
A monster's spell calls down a bolt of lightning on you
A skeleton rattles noisily at you (you freeze for a moment)
A thrown boomerang comes back and hits you: "Klonk!"
A boulder falls into a pit or hole and fills it
A cow-like monster bellows (angry)
A cow-like monster moos
Quaffing from a fountain: a large bubble rises and a water nymph appears
A soldier plays a bugle to wake the barracks (reveille)
An insect monster buzzes (chatting, or angry)
A peaceful dog barks (#chat)
A hostile dog growls (#chat), or a pet dog turns on you
A dog-like monster howls (also a werewolf howling at the moon)
A pet dog whines (hungry, or kept from what it wants)
A pet dog yelps when you hurt or abuse it
A well-fed pet dog yips (#chat)
A dingo yowls (#chat; dingos don't bark)
An explosion shatters an iron chain
A drawbridge is raised: chains rattle and gears turn
Turning undead (you chant an arcane formula), or an invisible choir chants
A bird-like monster chirps
A hard helmet saves a head: falling rocks, an iron ball, a thrown object
A monster grows too big to hold its shield: it falls with a clank
Quaffing from a sink: clanking from the pipes
Digging with a pick-axe into iron bars or something too hard: "Clash!"
A cockatrice hisses at someone (turning them to stone)
A monster breathes in something nasty (a breath attack, a gas cloud) and coughs
A throne room on the level: courtly conversation
A monster grows and bursts out of its armor
An electric attack: the air crackles with electricity
Using a stethoscope in Gehennom: the crackling of hellfire
Something glass shatters where you can see it (a mirror, a potion, a crystal ball...)
Kicking a wall reveals a secret door or passage: "Crash!"
Something glass shatters out of sight: "You hear something shatter!"
Kicking a throne to pieces: "CRASH! You destroy it."
A monster out of sight digs a hole and falls through the floor
A cave-in: "Crash! The ceiling collapses around you!"
A boulder falls into a pit or hole under you: a CRASH beneath you
Rock crashes: a cave-in around you, or a monster digging through rock
A door is forced open out of sight (force bolt, striking): a crashing sound
A crocodile bellows
A boulder or statue is smashed apart (force bolt, striking)
A rust monster or rock mole eats metal out of sight: crunching
A drawbridge's portcullis falls and crushes someone
A magic trap: a deafening roar (you may be deafened)
A dragged iron ball tears through a web
Killing a peaceful: the rumble of distant thunder (your god is displeased)
Praying successfully: divine music
A monster smashes down a door
A monster opens a door
A monster unlocks and opens a door
Dropping a ring down a sink: loud noises from the drain
A monster tries to spit venom but has none left: a dry rattle
Eggs break inside a kicked box or chest
Eggs splat when a kicked box or chest lands
An elephant-like monster (mastodon, mumak) trumpets
A horse-like monster neighs
A horse-like monster whickers
A horse-like monster whinnies
An explosion out of sight (a booby-trapped door blowing up, near or far)
Reading the Book of the Dead without the Bell of Opening: a faint chime
Two puddings merge out of sight: faint sloshing
Using a stethoscope on water: faint splashing
A cat-like monster meows
A kitten mews
A happy cat-like monster purrs
A pet cat yowls when you hurt or abuse it
A distressed pet cat whimpers
A cat-like monster yowls (angry or hungry)
Quaffing from a fountain: it bubbles furiously (snakes or a demon come out)
Playing the passtune at a drawbridge: gears turn
A drawbridge is lowered: gears turn and chains rattle
Glass breaks inside a kicked box (a muffled crash)
Glass shatters inside a kicked box or chest
A monster groans
Arriving in the Valley of the Dead: groans and moans everywhere
A dog-like monster growls
A monster grunts
A vault on the level: the footsteps of a guard on patrol
A water monster gurgles
Kicking a fountain or sink: a gushing sound
Using a stethoscope on yourself: your heartbeat
A snake or reptile hisses
Using a stethoscope on a wall with a secret door: a hollow sound
A monster plays a fire or frost horn (near or far)
Punished, going downstairs: "The iron ball drags you downstairs!"
Falling down stairs or a hole while punished: the iron ball smacks into you
Objects tumble down a hole or trap door
A jabberwock burbles
A land mine goes off: "KAABLAMM!!!"
A booby-trapped box or chest explodes when opened: "KABOOM!!"
A storm on the Plane of Air: "Kaboom!!! Boom!! Boom!!"
A booby-trapped door explodes: "KABOOM!! You see a door explode."
Digging a hole under a boulder: "KADOOM! The boulder falls in!"
Pushing a boulder into water out of sight: "Kerplunk!"
Kicking a door: it crashes open
Kicking a door: it shatters to pieces
Locking a box or chest: "Klick!"
Unlocking a box or chest: "Klunk!"
Kicking a sink: "Klunk! The pipes vibrate noisily."
A monster laughs (giggles, chuckles; also a cursing attack)
Kicking a box or chest: the lid slams open, then falls shut

A drawbridge's portcullis falls into the moat
A beehive on the level: a low buzzing

Reading a scroll of scare monster while confused: maniacal laughter
A monster eats a corpse out of sight: a masticating sound
A monster drinks a potion out of sight: a chugging sound
Pushing a boulder against a monster on the other side
Entering a shop with a pick-axe: the shopkeeper mutters imprecations
A shopkeeper repairs shop damage, muttering an incantation
An orc grunts
A paranoid confirmation prompt: answer "yes" to be sure

Rubbing a gem on a touchstone: "A sharp crack shatters" it
A shrieker shrieks (it draws monsters to you)
Blowing a whistle (also the vault guards' whistles when they turn angry)

A boulder drops into lava out of sight: sizzling
A monster eats objects out of sight (a gelatinous cube...): slurping
A drawbridge closes on someone: smashing and crushing
A pet snake turns on you: it rattles
Quaffing from a fountain: a stream of water moccasins pours out, hissing

Something falls into water: "Splash!"
A thrown egg hits a monster: "Splat!"
You get regurgitated, or expelled "with a squelch", from an engulfer

A rodent squeaks
